title: World Cup Golden Boot Winners
description: The top scorers who fired their way to the Golden Boot.

questions.q: Who won the Golden Boot at the 2022 World Cup?
questions.explain: Mbappé scored eight goals, including a final hat-trick.

questions.q: Who won the Golden Boot at the 2018 World Cup?
Which Colombian won the Golden Boot at the 2014 World Cup?
questions.explain: James Rodríguez scored six, including a stunning volley vs Uruguay.

questions.q: Who won the Golden Boot in 2006 with five goals?
questions.explain: Germany's Klose top-scored on home soil.

questions.q: Which Brazilian won the Golden Boot in 2002?
questions.explain: Ronaldo scored eight goals as Brazil won the title.

questions.q: Croatia's Davor Šuker won the Golden Boot in which year?
questions.explain: Šuker scored six as Croatia finished third in 1998.

questions.q: Who scored a record 13 goals to win the 1958 scoring charts?
questions.explain: France's Just Fontaine's 13 goals remain a single-tournament record.

questions.q: The Golden Boot was named the 'Golden Shoe' until being renamed in which decade?
questions.explain: It was renamed the Golden Boot from the 2010 World Cup.
